message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are typically handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the **Code Enforcement Division**. Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | How to File | Contact Info |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| **1. Online** | Use the City of Atlanta’s official website. Navigate to the “Noise Complaint” section under the “Police” or “Code Enforcement” pages. Fill out the form with details such as location, time, and description of the noise. | [City of Atlanta Noise Complaint Form](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) |
| **2. Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line at **(404) 656-4000**. They can take your complaint and dispatch an officer if necessary. | (404) 656-4000 |
| **3. In Person** | Visit the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office. Bring any evidence (e.g., audio recordings, timestamps). | City Hall: 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |
| **4. 311 Service** | Dial **311** from any phone in Atlanta. This service connects you to the city’s non-emergency services, including noise complaints. | 311 |

### Tips for a Successful Complaint
- **Provide Specific Details**: Include the exact address, time, and nature of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).
- **Evidence Helps**: If possible, record the noise or note the duration.
- **Follow Up**: If you don’t hear back within a few days, call the police or code enforcement to check on the status.

### When to Call 911
If the noise is part of an emergency (e.g., a fire, a violent incident), call **911** immediately. For non-emergency noise complaints, use the methods above.

Feel free to let me know if you need more detailed instructions or help with a specific situation!
